title: Who can wake the already awake?
odia:
ଚେଇଁ ଶୋଇବ ଯିଏ
ତାକୁ ଉଠାଇବ କିଏ?
literal_meaning: Who will wake someone who sleeps while awake?
meaning_odia: ଚେଇଁ ଥାଇ ଶୋଇବା ଅର୍ଥ ଏଠାରେ ଶୋଇବାର ଛଳନା। ଯିଏ ଜାଣିଶୁଣି ନଜାଣିବା ପରି ରହେ, ତାକୁ କେବଳ ବୁଝାଇଦେଲେ କିପରି ସଚେତନ କରାଯିବ—କଥାଟି ସେହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରୁଛି। ଅଜ୍ଞତା ଓ ସ୍ୱୀକାର କରିବାକୁ ଅନିଚ୍ଛା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ତଫାତ ଏହାର କେନ୍ଦ୍ର।
explanation: Someone genuinely asleep can be awakened; someone only pretending to sleep already has the awareness that waking would supply. The inspected public use makes the pretence explicit. Our reading applies the paradox to deliberate refusal to acknowledge what one already knows.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A participant has understood the agreed plan but repeatedly acts as though it was never explained. A colleague quotes the couplet to distinguish unwillingness from misunderstanding.
cultural_context: The opening puts waking and sleeping together in a deliberate contradiction. The answering question shifts attention from the person pretending to the frustrated effort of anyone trying to rouse them.

witnesses.locator: Page18, couplet beginning ଚେଇଁ ଶୋଇବ ଯିଏ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026. Exact words and line break retained; space before question mark normalised.
Quotes ଚେଇଁ ଶୋଇବ ଯିଏ ତାକୁ ଉଠେଇବ କିଏ and describes feigned sleep while awake. Public ଉଠେଇବ differs from displayed upload ଉଠାଇବ.

odia_summary: ଜାଣିଶୁଣି ଅଜଣା ପରି ରହୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ବୁଝାଇବାର ଅସୁବିଧା।
english_summary: Awareness alone cannot resolve deliberate pretence.
